Blind recompute for a study in an agent-based simulation (ACL study UV3). Please compute only from the data below; you have not seen and should not guess any earlier result. Data: per world (seed) and cell (age bin / situation / action), for habit updates in two periods (q1 = years 100-124, q4 = years 175-199): n_q1, sumG_q1, n_q4, sumG_q4 = the number of updates and the sum of the realized return G. Compute: (1) pool each cell over the 32 seeds; common support = cells with pooled n_q1 >= 100 AND pooled n_q4 >= 100; (2) coverage per period = updates in common-support cells / all updates in that period (all cells); (3) fixed weights w_c = (pooled n_q1 + pooled n_q4) of the cell / the sum over common cells (from counts only); (4) Delta G = sum over common cells of w_c x (pooled sumG_q4/n_q4 - pooled sumG_q1/n_q1) (4 decimals); (5) its 95% interval by a world bootstrap: resample the 32 seeds with replacement 10,000 times; in each resample pool the cells again; keep the weights fixed; if a common cell has no updates in q1 or q4 in that resample, leave it out and renormalize the remaining weights; take the 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles; (6) frozen rule: 'inconclusive' if coverage < 0.80 in either period; else 'returns rising' if the interval lies wholly above +0.05; 'returns stable' if it lies inside [-0.05, +0.05]; 'returns falling' if wholly below -0.05; else 'mixed'. Report the number of common cells, the coverage in each period, Delta G with its interval, and the reading. Run code if you can.
